item.title: Terac: Offensive Cybersecurity Engineers: Build RL Environments for AI Evaluation
item.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://terac.com

What We're Researching

We're hiring offensive cybersecurity experts for a long-term paid project focused on AI evaluation. Our goal is to build and harden reinforcement learning environments that test the limits of frontier AI models. This work directly contributes to understanding and mitigating advanced security risks in emerging technologies.

How It Works

You will work remotely on an hourly basis to design and implement complex cybersecurity benchmarks. Your tasks will involve creating robust reinforcement learning environments tailored for offensive security scenarios. You will continuously harden these environments to ensure they provide rigorous evaluations for AI systems. The project requires ongoing collaboration and iterative development to keep pace with new vulnerabilities.

Who This Is For

We welcome offensive cybersecurity engineers, penetration testers, and security researchers with strong technical backgrounds. Ideal candidates have hands-on experience building secure environments or developing security benchmarks. Familiarity with reinforcement learning or AI evaluation frameworks is highly valued but not strictly required.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build offensive cybersecurity reinforcement learning environments

  • Harden existing benchmarks to withstand advanced AI interactions

  • Develop rigorous evaluation criteria for frontier AI models

  • Collaborate on a long-term hourly basis to iterate on security scenarios

Who Should Apply

  • Professional experience in offensive cybersecurity or penetration testing

  • Strong background in building or hardening technical environments

  • Comfortable working on long-term hourly remote projects

  • Interest in AI safety and model evaluation

Compensation

$150 per hour

 

Ready to participate?

Start your paid interview now

 

About Terac

Terac is building the world's largest pool of vetted human experts for AI. Researchers, AI labs, and product teams use Terac to recruit, screen, and pay study participants across industries, languages, and skill sets.

 

Learn more at terac.com or on YouTube at @jointerac.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/terac-offensive-cybersecurity-engineers-build-rl-environments-for-ai-evaluation

item.title: Testlio: Trabajo Freelance en Perú | Prueba de Pagos con Yape
item.description:
Headquarters: Peru
URL: https://testlio.com

We're Testlio, a global software testing company that works with businesses around the world to improve the quality of their digital products, including apps, websites, and online payment experiences.

We're currently looking for people in Peru who use Yape to help us check that online payments work correctly for local customers. All of our freelancer projects are 100% remote. 

Requirements:

  • Currently living in Peru.
  • Have an active Yape account.
  • Conversational English to provide feedback
  • Availability for approximately 30-60 minutes.

What does the testing involve?
You'll make a real purchase from a well-known online store using Yape, just like you normally would. The goal is to check that the payment process works correctly from start to finish.
You'll be asked to:

  • Follow simple instructions from our team.
  • Complete a purchase using Yape on your phone or computer.
  • Record your screen during the process and upload the recording through a form.

This is a paid freelance opportunity ($12/hr)  No previous software testing experience is required.  If your profile is a match, a member of our team will reach out with more details and next steps. Please note that all official emails from our team come from an @testlio domain email address.

#LI-REMOTE

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/testlio-trabajo-freelance-en-peru-prueba-de-pagos-con-yape

item.title: Secure Privacy: Senior Full-Stack Web Developer (.NET/C#/MongoDB/Angular/Redux) – AI-First, with GDPR Experience
item.description:
Headquarters: Europe (DK)
URL: https://secureprivacy.ai

Secure Privacy is expanding, and we’re looking for an experienced Senior Full-Stack Developer with expertise in .NET, C#, and MongoDB, along with GDPR experience, to join our team! You’ll work remotely with a diverse group of developers, helping us build cutting-edge data privacy solutions for global clients. This role focuses on creating and optimizing APIs and backend services. If you’re passionate about clean, maintainable code, we’d love to hear from you!

What You’ll Do:
  • Develop and maintain backend services with C# and .NET.
  • Develop and maintain frontend logic with Angular and Redux.
  • Use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) as a core part of your daily workflow, and help the team get more out of them.
  • Work closely with designers to bring high-quality, scalable, and maintainable solutions to life.
  • Engage in all stages of the development process: planning, coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Advocate for best practices and contribute to improving our development standards.
  • Collaborate in a remote environment, primarily during European business hours.
What We’re Looking For:
  • 5+ years of backend development experience, particularly with C# and .NET Framework.
  • Hands-on, daily experience with AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code on real projects, including giving agents good context and critically reviewing AI-generated code.
  • Expertise in MongoDB, including complex operations (aggregations, compound indexes, transactions).
  • Experience with GDPR, CCPA, or other data privacy compliance standards.
  • Experience in Angular development, including NgRx or other Redux frameworks, is desirable.
  • Experience with payment platforms such as Stripe.
  • Strong Git skills, including modern branching strategies and ways of working.
  • Familiarity with profiling web apps for high availability and scalability.
  • Ability to make informed decisions between server-side and client-side code.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with non-engineers.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving, with a high level of discipline and independence.
  • Startup experience.
Bonus Points If You Have:
  • Experience building MCP servers.
  • Open source contributions.
  • StackOverflow or other community contributions.
  • Mobile app or SDK experience.
To apply, submit your CV and a short Loom video (max 2 minutes) introducing yourself and how you use AI to develop faster without compromising quality.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/secure-privacy-senior-full-stack-web-developer-net-c-mongodb-angular-redux-ai-first-with-gdpr-experience

item.title: WelcomeHome Software: Senior Software Engineer
item.description:
Headquarters: Atlanta, Georgia
URL: https://www.welcomehomesoftware.com/homecarecrm?utm_term=home%20care%20software&utm_campaign=Lead+Gen+-+Home+Care+-+Branded+%26+General&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=3279896849&hsa_cam=22158696391&hsa_grp=179100793812&hsa_ad=730236934988&hsa_s

About WelcomeHome

WelcomeHome is an Atlanta-based SaaS provider with the mission to build the best Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform in the Senior Living and Home Care space. Since launch in 2019, we have sustained consistent and rapid growth, expanding from four to 100+ employees.

To date, we’ve succeeded with a focused team that prioritizes client success over external / VC reporting and updates.

WelcomeHome’s differentiation extends beyond providing the most technologically advanced, easy-to-use software in the space. Clients receive world class support, from the migration from their legacy CRM platform to ongoing day-to-day training and troubleshooting.

 

About the Role:

WelcomeHome is looking for Senior Ruby on Rails Engineers excited about building user-friendly software solutions. This role is fully remote (based in the U.S.), will report to our VP of Engineering (based in Las Vegas), and play an integral role in product development and have the opportunity to impact several areas of the business.

Tech Stack

  • Backend: Ruby on Rails 8 / Ruby 3.3 (currently upgrading to Ruby 4)
  • Frontend: Haml, Stimulus, minimal React (where it earns its place)
  • Testing: Minitest + Capybara, TDD throughout
  • Data/Async: PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq
  • Infrastructure: AWS (Aurora, S3, EC2) via Cloud66
  • AI: Pi, Codex, and Claude Code used in the daily dev workflow

 

A great candidate might have:

  • Deep experience with Ruby on Rails
  • 5+ years software engineering experience
  • Passion for building high quality software focused on the user experience
  • Ability to take ownership and work well with others
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently to problem solve and offer solutions
  • Experience using Claude Code (or comparable AI tools) as part of your daily development workflow
  • Prior experience in a growth stage company or start-up

 

What You'll Get

WelcomeHome values all of its employees and strives to provide a competitive compensation package. Benefits include health, vision and dental coverage, 401(k) matching, paid parental leave, and unlimited PTO.

But, on top of that, you'll be surrounded by awesome people who care deeply about what they do and will do whatever it takes to help you succeed

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/welcomehome-software-senior-software-engineer

item.title: BDF EXPERTS: SAP Berater FI/CO (M/W/D)
item.description:
Headquarters: Germany Düsseldorf

Werde zum Architekten digitaler Finanzwelten – und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft! Zahlen sind Deine Leidenschaft, die Financial Supply Chain und SAP FI/CO Dein Spielfeld? Perfekt! Denn als Consultant wirst Du:

Aufgaben

Digitale Finanzwelten erschaffen – Du berätst und implementierst SAP FI/CO-Lösungen, die unsere Kunden begeistern

  • Geschäftsprozesse neu denken – Du analysierst, designst und revolutionierst Finanzprozesse
  • Wissen teilen und multiplizieren – In Deinen Workshops und Schulungen machst Du aus Anwendern echte Power-User
  • Konzepte entwickeln, die beeindrucken – Deine Fachkonzepte sind so klar wie durchdacht
  • Bestehende Lösungen auf das nächste Level heben – Du entwickelst SAP- und BDF-Lösungen kontinuierlich weiter

Qualifikation

Du bist unser Perfect Match, wenn Du:

  • Einen Abschluss in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in der Tasche hast
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrungen als SAP FI/CO-Berater gesammelt hast
  • Die SAP-Module FI und CO oder FSCM bereits kennst und Dich dort weiter einarbeiten möchtest
  • Erfahrungen im SAP-Customizing sammeln konntest
  • Komplexe Zusammenhänge schnell erfasst und in klare Konzepte übersetzt
  • Nicht nur mit Zahlen, sondern auch mit Menschen hervorragend kommunizieren kannst
  • Auf Deutsch und Englisch überzeugst – egal ob in Meetings oder Dokumentationen
  • Den Kunden immer in den Mittelpunkt stellst und flexibel auf Anforderungen reagierst
  • Bereit bist, gelegentlich zu reisen (keine Sorge, wir schicken Dich nicht auf Weltreise)
  • Erfahrungen und Interesse an der Erarbeitung von KI Use Cases hast

Benefits

Bei uns erwartet Dich mehr als nur ein Job:

  • Abwechslung garantiert! Kein Tag gleicht dem anderen in unserem dynamischen Team
  • Work-Life-Balance leben mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
  • Wachse über Dich hinaus durch individuelle Weiterbildungen, die zu Dir passen
  • Ideen statt Hierarchien – bei uns zählt Dein Input, nicht Dein Titel
  • Gestalte aktiv mit und sieh, wie Deine Ideen Wirklichkeit werden

Heute Consultant, morgen...? Bei uns kannst Du:

  • Einen langfristigen Karriereweg einschlagen – vielleicht als zukünftiger Projektleiter oder Solution Specialist
  • Teil eines Unternehmens sein, das in den Bereichen Controlling, Corporate Finance und Treasury Management Maßstäbe setzt
  • Mit Deinem Know-how direkt zum Unternehmenserfolg beitragen

Dann lass uns reden! Erzähle uns in einem kurzen Motivationsschreiben, warum Du perfekt in die BDF-Familie passt, und bewirb Dich noch heute!

Deine Ansprechpartnerin
Karin van Soest

P.S.: Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen – und gemeinsam die digitale Zukunft zu gestalten!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bdf-experts-sap-berater-fi-co-m-w-d
